page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2a family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 48.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type operates on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power relative to memory capacity. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent execution without resource contention. This hardware profile is appropriate for workloads such as batch processing, web serving, and distributed compute tasks that do not demand large memory footprints or local storage.
